section_summary: This section records Japanese merchant vessel movements reported by U.S. diplomatic and consular posts in February 1941. Most incoming telegrams are followed by State Department paraphrases sent to the Navy; several Kobe and Osaka reports instead list vessels granted bills of health. The reports cover routes through the Americas, the Pacific and South and Southeast Asia, with occasional cargo details.
